item.description: A 14-year-old boy has been charged over a motorhome fire in the Newcastle suburb of Wallsend.

item.title: ABC News: Smart glasses present 'elevated risk' to patients, says NT Health
item.description: The Northern Territory health department has issued a ban to its staff around the use of smart glasses, as part of an internal department review into its privacy policies triggered by a recent breach.

item.title: ABC News: Six childcare centres to close in SA after failing to find buyer
item.description: Six Edge Early Learning centres will permanently close across South Australia tomorrow, leaving families scrambling at short-notice to find alternative care for their children.

item.title: ABC News: Deputy governor concedes RBA is losing Australians' trust to manage inflation
item.description: Trust in the RBA is under strain "just as we need it most", RBA deputy governor warns.

item.title: ABC News: Deportation likely after Brit sentenced for animal cruelty in WA
item.description: Bradley Gavin Knoeson's lawyer said the act was "out of character" for his "dog lover" client, who is likely to be deported.

item.title: ABC News: Bandicoot research uncovers new subspecies amid conservation calls
item.description: Researchers say new discoveries about bandicoot species could have conservation implications for South Australian populations of the marsupials.

item.title: ABC News: Prominent harness racing trainer's company goes into liquidation
item.description: A company directed by a prominent Tasmanian harness racing trainer has gone into liquidation with significant debt, owing creditors more than $737,000.

item.title: ABC News: Security contractor denies alleged gangster was zip-tied during flight
item.description: One of seven masked security contractors at the centre of an alleged Sydney underworld figure's contested extradition denied the accused murderer was illegally restrained.

item.title: ABC News: Former mining town's preschool again at risk of lead exposure
item.description: The Captains Flat community has concerns about how ongoing lead exposure risks are being managed in their hometown, after elevated lead levels were detected at their preschool.

item.title: ABC News: Lamarre-Condon tells jury he tried going through Baird's phone as he slept
item.description: Former police officer Beau Lamarre-Condon admitted to entering Jesse Baird's home and going through his phone in testimony at his double murder trial.

item.title: ABC News: Trump's tendency to lash out after losing has some observers nervous
item.description: The midterms may change the obeisance that has been paid to Trump and an administration that has become increasingly dangerous in its reckless disregard for its impact on the rest of the world.

item.title: ABC News: NAS weighs in more than 33kg heavier than Paul Gallen
item.description: Nelson Asofa-Solomona has continued his verbal attack on Paul Gallen, setting the scene for an explosive heavyweight bout between the NRL premiership winners.

item.title: ABC News: Pilot died while trying to avoid power pole, final report finds
item.description: A final report into a plane crash on the Lower Eyre Peninsula that killed pilot Jarred Wait found he died while trying to avoid a power pole during wheat spraying.

item.title: ABC News: IVF, abortion and more set to cease at Newcastle private hospitals
item.description: IVF, elective abortions, voluntary assisted dying and gender reassignment surgeries are set to cease if the sale of two Newcastle hospitals is approved.

item.title: ABC News: It was a 90s anthem that made millions from a 'stolen' sweet lullaby
item.description: The song for an orphan recorded in an isolated Pacific community was used by a French band for a global hit adopted by corporate giants, but the singer and her family never saw a cent. Now a push is on to make amends.
